story_text:
## HIYD At Glance
## HIYD is a small waterproof and magnet-free sensor that attaches under your watch. It tracks your sleep, recovery, heart, nutrition and more. No notifications or distractions. No fees or subscription for Kickstarter backers.
- Keep your watch and style. No more bands, rings or other wearables.
- HIYD is tiny. Only 2.7mm thin and 25mm across
- Data privacy. Your data is yours. Now and forever.
- No subscription. Free for life for all Kickstarter backers.
- Battery life up to 20 days. With additional BatteryBand. 4 days without.
- Fits 95% of watches and straps. From "NATO Style" straps to women's sizes.
- Kickstarter discount. Pledge now for launch pricing before we hit retail!
- FREE Soft Band. Choose your color, FREE with every HIYD bought on Kickstarter.
## Are you one of the 15000+ people to reserve a VIP spot?
Your special VIP reservation price and gift (additional Soft Band) is waiting for you Check your email for the link. Thanks again ❤️
## Your Watch Means Something
## Maybe it was a gift. Maybe you bought it to mark a milestone. Maybe it was your father's. A watch means something. It isn't just a wearable.
Smartwatches ask you to trade all that for a screen and distractions. Plenty of us tried. Most of us went back to the watches we love.
Smart rings and fitness bands aren't much better. A band means wearing something on your other wrist. A ring can feel bulky and strange. Neither was designed around your style. And many people, us included, simply find them uncomfortable and ugly.
So you're left with a choice: The watch you love, or knowing how you sleep, recover and perform...
We're a team of ex Apple, Tesla and YC engineers who love watches ourselves.
We didn't think anyone should have to make that choice. So we built something that doesn't ask you to: HIYD. Earlier this year, we put our field prototype (which we called our Gen 1) into the hands of real customers and testers. Their feedback shaped everything we did next—and today, we’re excited to kick-start the HIYD Gen 2 right here on Kickstarter!
## Meet HIYD
## HIYD tracks your health accuretly and silently in the background.
No notifications. No sounds. No lights. No Alarms. No distractions.
Your watch looks exactly as it always has. Underneath, an optical window reads your pulse with red, infrared and green light. An accelerometer follows how you move. Together, they show how you sleep, recover, perform and more.
What HIYD tracks
- Heart rate, resting heart rate and HRV. The clearest signals of stress and fitness.
- Blood oxygen, respiratory rate and skin temperature. Early signs that something is off, often before you feel it.
- Sleep score and stages. How long you slept, and how well.
- Daily readiness. Whether today is for pushing or for recovering.
- Steps, activity and VO2 max. Every day in the background, plus how your cardio fitness is improving.
- Cycle tracking. Know where you are in your cycle.
- Nutrition. Log calories and macros alongside your sleep and recovery.
- Coach HIYD. An optional AI coach that explains your data in plain language. Free for life for backers.
The Science Behind HIYD
## A sensor this small has to earn your trust, which is why we put our technology through rigorous real-world testing.
During our early pilot program, users tracked core health metrics including sleep quality, daily steps, and Heart Rate Variability (HRV). When benchmarked directly against top industry competitors, our field prototype architecture delivered matching accuracy across key metrics, proving that world-class health tracking doesn't require compromising on style.
We studied every discrepancy, upgraded our components, and iterated on the design and software to make it even better. Check out our Gen 2 target specs below.
## Will HIYD fit?
## We designed HIYD to fit on 95% of modern watches, including unisex and women's models and "NATO Style" straps.
HIYD fits on square and rectangular models as well as classic designs, A-symmetrical and unique cases. As long as your caseback is 25mm then you can use HIYD. Wearing a NATO style strap? Do you have deep engraving on the case back? We have you covered. We've designed adapters for both cases. Check them out in the Add-ons.
30-day fit guarantee: Pledge with confidence. if HIYD doesn't securely attach to your watch case back, return it within 30 days for a full refund.
## HIYD Health App
## The HIYD Health app doesn't compete for your attention. No feeds. No badges. No streaks. Just helpful data you can actually use.
Open the HIYD Health app in the morning. You'll see how you slept, how recovered you are, and one suggestion for the day. Want more? Go deeper into sleep stages, HRV trends, heart rate across the day, and every meal you've logged. We have our app in test flight right now and we are doing the final testing before we get it approved on the App store and Play store.
- No subscription. Free for the life of the unit for Kickstarter backers. You won't pay to see your own health data or use the additional features like Coach HIYD.
- Your data is yours. It's encrypted in storage and in transit. We never sell it or share it. Your health data shouldn't go to the highest bidder. No compromises.
- HIYD works on iOS and Android, and syncs with Apple Health, Google Health, and Strava. We are working on additional integrations like Garmin, Peloton, and Suunto and are waiting on developer access.
## How HIYD Compares
## Most health trackers make you wear their device instead of your watch and pay every month to see your own data. HIYD doesn't.
We might be a bit old fashioned, but we don't think every single thing needs a subscription. Also we believe in privacy. Some things - like your private health data - should never be for sale. At HIYD we respect your privacy. Your data is yours; now and forever. Also Kickstarter backers get HIYD subscription free for the life of their unit.
## What's Inside The Box
When you purchase HIYD, you get our latest generation sensor in black, a soft band in any color you choose, our charger and our "Magsafe style" cable that can charge both your HIYD and can also charge your Battery Band. The HIYD Health app is also included free for all Kickstarter backers for the life of the unit.
## Choose Your Finish
HIYD comes in our standard black anodized aluminium case, but we plan to offer HIYD in Silver and Gold anodized aluminium colors for everyone that wants to match their HIYD to their case. The colored versions are available as an add-on. There is no difference between the units, only the color.
## Soft Band
The included Soft Band is approximately 4mm thick and comes in 4 colors, Onyx, Dune, Sage and Petal. The band allows you to use HIYD while in the gym, training, swimming, sleeping and for those days you just don't feel like wearing your watch. HIYD fits perfectly on the back. The Soft Band is made with a light, breathable, washable and interchangeable textile strap. The color is chosen via an exit survey at the end of the campaign!
## Battery Band
The Battery Band is approx. 10mm thick and comes in 4 colors, Onyx, Dune, Sage and Petal. The Battery Band charges fully in 45min, and holds at least 5 days of full charges for a HIYD unit. and is made with a light, breathable, washable and interchangeable textile strap. Get up to 20 days of charge. The color is chosen via an exit survey at the end of the campaign!
## Caseback Adapter
The Caseback Adapter was designed to allow you to use HIYD even if you have deep engravings on your watch caseback including relief casebacks, textured casebacks and raised casebacks. The plate is larger than the HIYD and uses a stronger nano suction to ensure a secure fit.
## "NATO Style" Adapter
The "NATO Style" Adapter is a thin steel clip with a plastic coating to prevent scratches, which we have developed to allow HIYD to clip on popular military style watch straps. It fits both nylon, leather and other "NATO Style" and Zulu style straps.
## Community Reactions
## From Geneva to Toronto, Paris to New York. We have presented HIYD to watchmakers, collectors, and enthusiasts and the reaction has been overwhelmingly positive.
Even the most traditional and conservative watch purists were amazed at how seamlessly HIYD disappears behind their watches. Below are some real reactions taken from our visits to Geneva Watch Days and We Love Watches Paris. You can see the full videos and more reactions on our YouTube channel.
## Our manufacturing plan in 2027 starts with the battery. Gen 2 runs on a custom battery, and the tooling to make it takes 6 to 8 weeks.
We start that process in January, so we expect that the first batch of units arrive at the end of January. Come February we would have finished prototypes, then testing. Once those units are in hand, we start rigorous testing and refine the design until it passes every required certification, including FCC.
Why your backing matters. The battery tooling is the main upfront cost. Every other part is bought per unit, so once the tooling is paid for, production grows with the number of orders.
## Meet Our Team
## Engineered by ex-Apple, Tesla, and Y Combinator alumni.
Inspired by a deep love for classic watches.
Too many projects operate from behind a curtain with anonymous founders and vague promises. We've all heard the horror stories. We believe in total transparency. You can see who we are, what we've done and hold us accountable to deliver. We will be sending updates weekly, and building publicly.
HIYD is a registered US company based in San Jose, California. Our team combines world-class hardware engineering, award winning marketing and adverting, with a genuine passion for horology.
We aren't just building HIYD, we are wearing it alongside our own watch collections and we are right here to answer all of your questions every step of the way. Join us and thousands of others in the HIYD VIP Facebook Group.
- Optical sensors. Green, red and infrared LEDs measure your heart rate, HRV and blood oxygen (SpO2).
- Accelerometer. It tracks your movement, which powers activity detection, step counting and sleep detection.
- Skin temperature sensor. A thermistor reads your skin temperature through the night to measure changes.
- Smarter together. Combining these sensors lets HIYD calculate your VO2 max, sleep stages, Readiness and calories burned.
- On-device memory. HIYD stores up to 2 days of data without a phone connection, so nothing is lost if you leave your phone behind.
In development
- Workout detection. HIYD will recognise when you start a workout and what kind it is.
- Cycle tracking. This needs large datasets to be accurate, so we won’t release it until it is, but this is a priority for our team.
## A Look At HIYD (The Prototype)
## The HIYD prototype has already been built and delivered to our first users. Everything we learned from it went into our Gen 2, the smaller sensor you’re backing here on Kickstarter.
In this video, and for the sake of being transparent our founder Salah shows off his resting heart rate on HIYD compared to a well known smart band. One real-world comparison, not a clinical study. We’d rather show you than tell you.
From Prototype to Finished Product
Our prototype is already on peoples' wrists. It uses the same micro suction attachment, the same green optical sensor and the same contact-pad charging as the finished product. So what did we change?
Well to start with the size. Gen 2 is significantly smaller. What made the prototype bigger was the battery: for our first batch we had to use an off-the-shelf cell, because there wasn’t time for custom tooling. Gen 2 keeps the proven architecture, but drops a few test-only components. Gen 2 will also get a custom-made battery, which is where most of the size reduction comes from.

risks: Building hardware is tough, and bringing a brand-new concept to the watch community requires absolute transparency. We treat our backers as part of the team, which means telling you exactly where things stand, what could go wrong, and how we plan to protect your support. Here is an honest look at our journey ahead and how we are preparing for it: 1. Design and Technology Optimization We are actively optimizing hardware integration and expanding product technology. While these technical upgrades may alter the final visual appearance of the product, any departure from the initial design will only be implemented if it delivers a significant net benefit to the customer. 2. Production, Sourcing & Timelines Schedules in hardware manufacturing can shift, but our target is firm: we plan to ship our very first batch by Q2 2027 at the latest. Where Components Come From: To give you world-class accuracy, our high-precision parts come from established leaders in Japan, Germany, Taiwan, and Korea. Our Safety Net: Global supply chains can be unpredictable. To protect our backers against unexpected bottlenecks or geopolitical delays, we’ve already lined up secondary production partners in Canada and Michigan ready to step in if needed. Our Promise: If there are any bumps along the road, you won't be left guessing. We commit to frequent, honest project updates so you’re with us every step of the way. 3. Fit & Compatibility We created HIYD because we love traditional watches, and we want you to be able to wear yours every day. While HIYD securely fits about 95% of watch casebacks, the world of watch design is vast. Known Exceptions: Heavily domed where the sensor cannot sit flush. A Built-in Alternative: We don't want your tracking to stop when you wear a unique watch piece. That’s why every pledge includes a dedicated band so you can wear the sensor continuously on its own whenever you like. Our 30-Day Fit Guarantee: We want you to back with total confidence. If HIYD doesn't attach securely to your favorite watch, simply return it within 30 days for a full refund, no hassle, no hard feelings. 4. Software Features & Community Openness Hardware is just half the story, software makes it all come alive. We are taking a transparent, phased approach to building out our ecosystem: What’s Ready vs. In Development: Core tracking functions will be polished and live on day one. faq.q: Will HIYD affect my mechanical watch?
faq.a: No. HIYD has no magnets, no wireless charging and no vibration motor. The field from its electronics is weaker than the Earth’s own. Your balance wheel, hairspring and rotor are untouched.

Yes. HIYD fits over 95% of modern watch casebacks regardless of material, provided there is at least 25mm of flat caseback space for a secure mount. While curved, heavily domed surfaces don't offer enough contact area to attach properly, watches with deep or high-relief engravings can easily bridge the gap using our Caseback Adapter available in the Add-ons section. You can back with complete confidence, every pledge is backed by our risk-free 30-Day Fit Guarantee, offering a full refund if HIYD…

No. We don't use any glue or adhesive to attach to your watch. We use a special silicone microsuction. No glue, no magnets and no tools needed. HIYD peels off with no residue. You can move it between watches as often as you like.

faq.q: How long does the battery last, and how do I charge it?
faq.a: Up to 20 days per charge with the battery band, with continuous tracking through workouts, workdays and sleep. Charge it on the three-pin contact charger (included), or wear the BatteryBand overnight and it charges while you sleep (available as an Add-on).

faq.q: What health data does HIYD track?
faq.a: The HIYD app brings all your essential health and fitness metrics into one intuitive dashboard. Seamlessly monitor your daily readiness and recovery alongside deep sleep insights, including sleep scores and stage tracking, while keeping tabs on key vitals like continuous heart rate, resting heart rate (RHR), and heart rate variability (HRV). Stay motivated throughout the day by tracking your active steps and calories, and effortlessly manage your diet by scanning meals, calories, and macros in s…

faq.q: Does it integrate with Apple Health, Google Health and Garmin?
faq.a: Yes. Your health data belongs to you, which is why we ensure your steps, sleep, and heart rate metrics stream effortlessly into your existing health ecosystem. We are also committed to expanding our software compatibility, with active development underway for direct integrations with Strava, Garmin, Suunto, and more. New platform connections will continue to roll out seamlessly through regular app updates.

No. Absolutely not. We use special silicone micro suction. No adhesive glues or harmful magnets. Your HIYD will fit securely in place during daily wear, and peel off completely clean, leaving zero residue, marks, or scratches behind, even on delicate polished gold, platinum, and glass casebacks.

faq.q: What if I don't wear a watch when I sleep?
faq.a: We have you covered. Some users prefer to keep HIYD on their watch 24/7 (also when they sleep), while others don't. That's why we designed our Soft Band. A soft flexible silicone band made for the HIYD sensor.

faq.q: What if I don't wear a watch when I workout or train?
faq.a: No worries. Some users prefer to keep HIYD on their watch even through workouts. while others prefer to slip the sensor into the comfortable Soft Band included with your order. HIYD works seamlessly either way. It’s fully sweat-proof and slip-proof, engineered to stay firmly in place no matter how intense your training gets. Guaranteed, or your money back.
Yes. HIYD is waterproof and can be used in the shower and the pool. However we do not recommend using HIYD when diving.

faq.q: How do you ensure data privacy and security?
faq.a: We use enterprise-grade encryption for all sensor data storage and transmission, keeping your information completely secure. More importantly: we NEVER sell or share your personal data. Ever. Your health and movement metrics are yours, and yours alone.

faq.q: When will I actually receive my HIYD?
faq.a: We are in final pre-production right now, and VIP depositors will get priority access to the final launch later this year. The first batch will ship by Q2 2027 at the latest. We know the hardware space comes with baggage and everyone has heard horror stories about projects ghosting or running years behind. But we aren't learning on your dime. We’ve already successfully launched Gen 1, and this launch is for HIYD Gen 2: thinner, more accurate, and with a significantly better battery. We know how…

faq.q: Does HIYD work with NATO style or ZULU style straps?
faq.a: Yes. We've developed an adapter for all NATO style and ZULU style watch straps. You can find it in the Add-ons.

faq.q: Does HIYD work on rectangular watches?
faq.a: Yes. As long as your watch caseback can fit the 25mm sensor then you can use HIYD. If your HIYD doesn't fit, then you are covered by our 30 day guarantee.
